usage: probe [-h] [-f] [-n N] [--dry-run] [-v] [-o OUTPUT] [-cd] [-no-color]
             [--color {auto,always,never}]
             [path]

argparse probe

positional arguments:
  path                  positional

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -f, --force           skip confirmation prompts
  -n, --limit N         maximum number of results to return, a deliberately
                        long description so that argparse has to wrap it onto
                        continuation lines
  --dry-run             print what would change
  -v, --verbose         increase verbosity
  -o, --output OUTPUT   write output to OUTPUT
  -cd, --print-config-dir
                        multi-letter single-dash alias
  -no-color             single-dash word option
  --color {auto,always,never}
                        choices placeholder
